job.job_description:
Role: LLMOps Engineer

Experience: 6 to 10 Years

Skills: LLMOps, GenAI, MLOps, Kubernetes, Docker, Python, Azure/AWS/GCP, CI/CD

Job Summary



Deploy, manage, and scale LLM-powered applications across cloud and hybrid environments.
Build and maintain production-grade inference pipelines for Generative AI workloads.
Design and implement LLMOps pipelines for model, prompt, and configuration lifecycle management.
Monitor latency, throughput, cost, errors, model drift, and hallucinations.
Develop dashboards, logging frameworks, and alerting systems to ensure service reliability.
Optimize inference performance and costs using caching, batching, routing, and autoscaling.
Implement security, governance, access control, and audit mechanisms for AI systems.
Collaborate with AI/ML, Responsible AI, and Application Engineering teams.
Enable enterprise AI adoption through reusable LLMOps platforms and frameworks.



Required Skills

Strong understanding of LLMs, Generative AI architectures, and inference workflows.
Experience operating LLM/GenAI solutions in production environments.
Hands-on expertise in Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines for ML/AI applications.
Proficiency in Python and automation scripting.
Knowledge of MLOps/LLMOps tools, observability, monitoring, and logging solutions.
Experience in performance tuning, scalability, and cost optimization of AI workloads.



Preferred Skills

Experience with Vector Databases, RAG, LangChain/LlamaIndex.
Exposure to AI governance, Responsible AI, and compliance frameworks.
Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or equivalent.



Experience

6 to 10 years of overall experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, MLOps, or AI Engineering.
2 to 4+ years of hands-on experience supporting ML/GenAI workloads in production.
